[Data utilities] Selects values from a JSON document with a JSONPath query (RFC 9535: names, indexes, slices, wildcards, .. descendants, filters with comparisons, && || ! and length/count/value) or a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901). Returns every match with its normalized path and pointer. Input: json and query (POST for large documents), optional max_results. Limits: 1 MB JSON, 1,000-character query; match() and search() are not offered. Offline.

json.description: JSON text, up to 1 MB (a JSON value is also accepted in a POST body or MCP arguments)

max_results.description: Values returned, 1-1000 (default 100); match_count is always the full count

query.description: JSONPath starting with $ (RFC 9535, e.g. $.items[?@.price < 10].name) or JSON Pointer starting with / (RFC 6901, e.g. /items/0/name)

name: json_query
title: JSON query: JSONPath (RFC 9535) or JSON Pointer
